test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

She couldn’t continue with a ______ diet to reduce her blood sugar.
solution: The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'balanced.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options: • ​**practiced **- done repeatedly or regularly, skilled in a particular activity. (अभ्यस्त) • **shortened **- made shorter or briefer. (संक्षिप्त) • **maintained **- kept in a certain condition. (रखा हुआ) • **balanced **- evenly distributed or proportioned. (संतुलित) • The context of the sentence is that the subject could not continue eating **a well-proportioned diet** full of all vitamins, minerals and other nutrients to reduce her blood sugar level. • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "balanced." • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4. • Another example: • *A **balanced** diet promotes good health and normal development.* Complete Sentence:__ *She couldn’t continue with a __balanced__ diet to reduce her blood sugar.* * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__*** • A **balanced diet **contains an adequate amount of all the nutrients required by the body to grow, remain healthy and be disease-free. 1c0:Ta66b,
